# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Dressmaker and domestic artisan  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha  <sub>[v1 c9 P27](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0027), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>; Mrs. Agatha  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Agatha Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

She is an elderly, rotund woman who sits by her kitchen window to knit and observe local activities.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)_

## Personality

Mrs. Sowerby is known for being outspoken, candid, and proud, often voicing her opinions without fear or partiality. Despite her sharp tongue and tendency to meddle or gossip, she possesses a deeply compassionate and caring nature, particularly toward those in need or suffering from illness. She holds strong, traditional views and maintains a devoted, maternal sense of duty.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P29](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0029), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

- Outspoken and opinionated  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>
- Compassionate and devoted caregiver  <sub>[v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>

- Crafting quilts and dressmaking  <sub>[v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Nursing and caregiving for the sick  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- Raising funds for community and parish needs  <sub>[v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000)</sub>
- Remaining in her home community of Brierley  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Sowerby spent many years residing on her family farm in Brierley with her husband, Thomas Sowerby. She frequently visited Grey Shutters and dropped by neighbors' homes to discuss local matters or solicit contributions for parish needs. When Nell Harcourt first arrived at Grey Shutters as a child, Mrs. Sowerby openly commented on her thin frame and freckles, sparking a violent outburst of rage from Nell and causing a brief strain in her visits. In later years, she cared untiringly for her husband throughout his prolonged illness until his silent passing. Facing financial hardship and the necessity of selling her farm after Thomas's death, she felt heartbroken at the prospect of leaving Brierley until Thirza Abernethy invited her to move into Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children, losing two who passed away  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Took out a mortgage on her farm eight years prior to help her youngest son move west  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
